exercises.title: Composite index: the column order that serves both queries
exercises.problemHtml:
Two frequent queries on Customer: (A) WHERE lastName = @l AND firstName = @f and (B) WHERE lastName = @l. Create ONE index ix_customer_name that lets both use an Index Seek.

Runs on YOUR SQL Server, not in the browser. The point is the KEY ORDER of a SQL Server index, read from sys.index_columns, and the seek you see in the SSMS plan. Nothing here is graded automatically: run the self-check check.sql on your machine and, when it prints ALL 3 CHECKS PASSED, press Mark as solved.

How to run it (Windows or macOS)

Press Tải .zip (download) above the code and unzip it. The folder has three files: setup.sql (re-creates a scratch database DBI202_CL with the sample tables), solution.sql (YOUR answer — edit only this one) and check.sql (3 checks; prints PASS/FAIL for each and ends with ALL 3 CHECKS PASSED). Always run them in this order: setup → solution → check.

  • Windows + SSMS (the course setup, lesson 0.3): open setup.sql → F5; open solution.sql → F5; open check.sql → F5, then read the Messages tab. Or in a terminal inside the folder (sqlcmd ships with SQL Server; otherwise winget install sqlcmd):
    sqlcmd -S localhost -E -C -i setup.sql,solution.sql,check.sql (use -U sa -P "<password>" instead of -E for a SQL login).
  • macOS (SQL Server in Docker, as in lesson 0.3 — Apple Silicon: mcr.microsoft.com/azure-sql-edge, Intel: mcr.microsoft.com/mssql/server:2022-latest):
    docker run -d --name dbi202-sql -e ACCEPT_EULA=Y -e "MSSQL_SA_PASSWORD=Dbi202#Lab" -p 1433:1433 mcr.microsoft.com/azure-sql-edge
    then install the command-line client once with brew install sqlcmd and, inside the folder:
    sqlcmd -S localhost,1433 -U sa -P "Dbi202#Lab" -C -i setup.sql,solution.sql,check.sql
    (or open the three files in VS Code with the SQL Server (mssql) extension and run them in the same order).

Use CREATE OR ALTER for procedures, functions, triggers and views so that you can run solution.sql again and again. In the real PE you submit only the CREATE … statement, without GO or test commands.

Requirements

  • A two-column key; think about which column every query mentions.
  • Then run both queries with the plan on (Ctrl+M).

exercises.title: Clustered vs nonclustered: put the table in date order
exercises.problemHtml:
Orders was created as a heap (no primary key). Almost every query reads a range of dates. (1) Add the primary key pk_orders on orderID as NONCLUSTERED; (2) create the clustered index cix_orders_date on (orderDate, orderID) so the rows are physically kept in date order.

Runs on YOUR SQL Server, not in the browser. CLUSTERED / NONCLUSTERED and heaps are SQL Server storage concepts checked in sys.indexes (PostgreSQL has no clustered index in this sense). Nothing here is graded automatically: run the self-check check.sql on your machine and, when it prints ALL 3 CHECKS PASSED, press Mark as solved.

How to run it (Windows or macOS)

Press Tải .zip (download) above the code and unzip it. The folder has three files: setup.sql (re-creates a scratch database DBI202_CL with the sample tables), solution.sql (YOUR answer — edit only this one) and check.sql (3 checks; prints PASS/FAIL for each and ends with ALL 3 CHECKS PASSED).     sqlcmd -S localhost -E -C -i setup.sql,solution.sql,check.sql (use -U sa -P "<password>" instead of -E for a SQL login).
  • macOS (SQL Server in Docker, as in lesson 0.3 — Apple Silicon: mcr.microsoft.com/azure-sql-edge, Intel: mcr.microsoft.com/mssql/server:2022-latest):
    docker run -d --name dbi202-sql -e ACCEPT_EULA=Y -e "MSSQL_SA_PASSWORD=Dbi202#Lab" -p 1433:1433 mcr.microsoft.com/azure-sql-edge
    then install the command-line client once with brew install sqlcmd and, inside the folder:
    sqlcmd -S localhost,1433 -U sa -P "Dbi202#Lab" -C -i setup.sql,solution.sql,check.sql
    (or open the three files in VS Code with the SQL Server (mssql) extension and run them in the same order).

Use CREATE OR ALTER for procedures, functions, triggers and views so that you can run solution.sql again and again. In the real PE you submit only the CREATE … statement, without GO or test commands.

Requirements

  • ALTER TABLE Orders ADD CONSTRAINT pk_orders PRIMARY KEY NONCLUSTERED (orderID);
  • CREATE CLUSTERED INDEX cix_orders_date ON Orders (orderDate, orderID);

# Read the plan: what does each operator mean? — answer key

1. Operator → meaningToán tử → ý nghĩa
   - r1.yn: every row of a heap is read
   - r2.yn: every row of the clustered index (the table) is read
   - r3.yn: the B-tree is entered by key to reach only matching rows
   - r4.yn: for each row found in a nonclustered index, fetch the missing columns from the table
   - r5.yn: every leaf page of a nonclustered index is read
   Scan = read everything; Seek = navigate by key. Key Lookup is the price of an index that does not cover the query — remove it with INCLUDE (lesson 8.B).VI: Scan = đọc hết; Seek = đi theo khoá. Key Lookup là cái giá của chỉ mục không phủ truy vấn — xoá nó bằng INCLUDE (bài 8.B).

solutionCodeJson.name: answers.md
solutionCodeJson.code:
# Which queries can seek on an index (x, y, z)? — answer key

1. WHERE x = 1 AND y = 2WHERE x = 1 AND y = 2
   Answer: b) seek on the pair (x, y)
   The leading prefix (x, y) is given.VI: Có tiền tố đầu (x, y).

2. WHERE y = 2 AND z = 3WHERE y = 2 AND z = 3
   Answer: d) no seek: leading column x missing
   Without x, the index order does not help.VI: Thiếu x thì thứ tự chỉ mục không giúp được.

3. WHERE x = 1 AND z = 3WHERE x = 1 AND z = 3
   Answer: a) seek on x, then z filters those rows
   The prefix stops at the first missing column (y); z becomes a residual filter.VI: Tiền tố dừng ở cột đầu tiên bị thiếu (y); z thành điều kiện lọc phụ.

4. WHERE x > 5 AND y = 2WHERE x > 5 AND y = 2
   Answer: b) seek on the x range; y filtered inside

exercises.solutionExplanationHtml:
Answer key / Đáp án

  1. b) seek on the pair (x, y)

    The leading prefix (x, y) is given.

    VI: Có tiền tố đầu (x, y).

  2. d) no seek: leading column x missing

    Without x, the index order does not help.

    VI: Thiếu x thì thứ tự chỉ mục không giúp được.

  3. a) seek on x, then z filters those rows

    The prefix stops at the first missing column (y); z becomes a residual filter.

    VI: Tiền tố dừng ở cột đầu tiên bị thiếu (y); z thành điều kiện lọc phụ.

  4. b) seek on the x range; y filtered inside

    After a range on a column, the following key columns cannot narrow the seek.

    VI: Sau một khoảng trên một cột, các cột khoá sau không thu hẹp seek được nữa.
